summary: Cresco Labs filed a Form 6-K with its management information circular for an October 30, 2026 annual general and special meeting. The Board recommends voting for all resolutions, including a reverse split (five to fifteen pre-split securities for one post-split) and a plan of arrangement creating a new British Columbia TopCo holding company that becomes the public parent while Cresco survives as a wholly owned subsidiary. No stake, price per share, premium, or break fee is stated; a special resolution also extends the U.S. exchange listing sunset for multiple voting shares. Watch arrangement approval, exchange ratio range, and redomicile tax/listing risks.
